subject: Kiosk PRN-0034-P2 screen frozen, unresponsive to touch input
description: The ordering kiosk at the Anna Nagar location is displaying a frozen screen and is not responding to any touch inputs. The display appears to be stuck on the main menu screen since approximately 11:45 AM this morning. Customers are unable to place orders using this unit. A basic power cycle was attempted by store staff without success. The kiosk requires immediate attention to restore service.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and logged. Initial troubleshooting steps to be provided to store manager via phone. Remote diagnostics will be attempted if basic steps fail.
